## Post checklist (SEO + editorial)

- [ ] `title` ≤ 60 chars, target keyword in the first half
- [ ] `description` 140–160 chars, contains the keyword
- [ ] No H1 (`# `) in the body — starts at `##`; H2s carry keyword variants
- [ ] ≥ 2 internal links (other posts or polywatch.org pages)
- [ ] `markets:` frontmatter lists every market discussed
- [ ] Every number traceable to the digest/source — **no invented figures**
- [ ] No advice language (bet on / should buy / guaranteed / free money …)
- [ ] Ends with one factual CTA line
